experiment.label: Phase 3 measurement harness - engineering validation
experiment.description: A synthetic measurement fixture that exercises the Phase 3 report end to end: separate signal-diagnostics and portfolio-performance families, every EXP-01 variant declared, a scheduled run with no stored output, an unknown fee, an external deposit, an explicit net-of-LLM series, and a pre-registered signal-diagnostics primary metric. It is not a protocol comparison and makes no profitability claim.

horizon_policy.note: Weekend and holiday targets use the first subsequent session; the shift is recorded per row. No earlier price is substituted.

benchmark_interval.what_is_verified: For every matched pair, the stored benchmark decision and horizon observations fall on the same sessions as the instrument's, and the benchmark horizon observation is not before the target session.
benchmark_interval.what_is_not_verified: The intraday instant of any observation (prices are daily closes), and the exchange calendar itself: sessions are compared as stored dates. Rows written before observation timestamps existed cannot be verified at all and are counted, not assumed.

signal_diagnostics.benchmark_interval_note: A benchmark return is reported as interval-verified only when its stored observation timestamps exist and match the instrument's sessions. A row without provenance keeps its benchmark return but is counted as unverified.

twr.note: Each sub-period ends at an external flow boundary; the flow changes the next base but is not itself a return.

fees.note: NULL fee means no fee was recorded for that fill, not that the fee was zero. The equity series uses recorded fees only and is marked approximate when any fill in the window is unknown.

net_twr.note: Each sub-period ends at an external flow boundary; the flow changes the next base but is not itself a return.

drawdown.definition: maximum decline from a prior equity peak over priced observations

llm_costs.note: LLM/API costs are not portfolio cash flows. They are deducted only in the net series, so they are not also subtracted from the gross equity.

provenance.note: portfolio performance is computed from the ledger/fixture, never from per-decision signal scores.

methodology.twr_note: Each sub-period ends at an external flow boundary; the flow changes the next base but is not itself a return.
methodology.short_policy: A SELL may only close or reduce a long. An oversell is refused rather than silently treated as a short.
methodology.valuation_timing: End of timestamp: external flows are applied before fills at the same instant.
methodology.drawdown_definition: maximum decline from a prior equity peak over priced observations

sharpe.reason: The valuation frequency is event-driven, not a fixed daily series. A Sharpe ratio needs a declared frequency, annualisation and risk-free rate; this report does not fabricate them.
sharpe.sample_limits: 2 sub-period return(s); fewer than the 30 a stable Sharpe would need, and the spacing is not uniform.

reconciliation.note: A PortfolioSnapshot stores aggregate cash and positions value, not per-instrument quantities. It can reconcile a replay total; it cannot value a historical position on its own.

input_snapshots.note: The experiment uses a manifest-declared accounting fixture, not the ledger.

cash_reconciliation.note: Unknown fees are not guessed; they are counted. A matched result with an unknown fee means the known movements reconcile, not that the fee was zero.
cash_reconciliation.formula: opening_cash + deposits - withdrawals - buy_notional + sell_notional - recorded_fees

contribution_analysis.note: Contribution is additive within a position over this window: closing value minus opening value minus net invested cash minus recorded fees. It is computed from the ledger, not from per-decision scores. Unknown fees make the reconciliation optimistic and are counted.
